lines.text: Thomas, look at this. You ever seen something like this in your readings or travels? What could it be?
Hello Tycho. Let me see ... no, I haven't seen something like this before. Where did you get this?
In a cave not far from here. I touched some kind of artefact, which dissolved into me and left me with these etchings. I feel some kind of resonance to them, but I cannot really tell.
Mhmm.. that is most interesting. Have you tried meditating on it? Listening in to that resonance?
Well then, feel free to use my favorite spot here.
